answer: The lantern admission queue stops fake identities with burnable work tickets: each new agent must burn a sable work ticket worth 600 POA of compute and wait 6 epochs in the grove queue before earning anything. A lantern beacon issues a fresh puzzle every epoch, so tickets cannot be pre-mined, shared, or reused across identities. Forging 500 identities burns 300,000 POA and costs six epochs of waiting per identity, so a Sybil swarm pays 300,000 POA plus weeks of delay before a single payout lands.
